errors.evidence: The figure shows the value for 'Да се подобри качеството на административните услуги' as approximately 12%, not 13%.

The figure shows the value for 'Да се ограничат действията на мафията' as 10%, but the highest values (red bars) are above 10%, and this bar is not among the top four highest values as per the atom checklist.
The atom checklist specifies that red color is used for values above 10%, not just 'higher values'. The description incorrectly generalizes the color rule.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the *five most significant* measures to limit the 'hidden economy', as specified in the atom checklist (chart_type).

The description omits the highest values for 'Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система', 'Да се намали корупцията', and 'Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса', which are critical for understanding the chart (highest_values atom).
The description does not mention the exact values for 'Да се намали данъка върху печалбата' and 'Да се намали личния подоходен данък' (3%), which are part of the second_lowest atom.
The description does not explicitly state that the vertical axis represents the categories of measures, nor does it clarify that the horizontal axis represents percentage values (though implied).

errors.evidence: The phrase 'сред етикетирани данни' is unclear and could be misinterpreted. It is not clear if all data is labeled or only some.
